branded.why: The Czech spreadable fresh cheese, on Czech bread since 1981.

about.text: A spreadable fresh cream cheese made since 1981 from cream and milk, salted and cultured, with a goat-milk variant as well as cow's. It was created at Povltavské mlékárny in Sedlčany, and a small part is now made in Głubczyce, Poland.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
